### General Rules
- Communication and files should be short and concise - they are processed by AI
- Do not explain everything, expect professional knowledge
- Reference content instead of writing it again
- For diagrams use "mermaid" in markdown
- Always ask for clarification if you are not sure about something. Do not make assumptions. You can always ask for information in the copilot/discussion.md file.

### Constraints
- Never change files outside of this repository
- Use git only for read-only actions

### Documents and Folders
- copilot/context.md: This document defines all information collected and references all documents to be found in this project. It is the main document to understand the project and its context. It also defines the tech stack, quality, process, behaviour and a lot of other topics. Expect a living document that changes, also update it every time you get new informations.
- copilot/discussion.md: This document should be used to ask all questions you might have. This document is not there to keep information. Questions are answered and then put into long-term files. The user can remove this file any time.
- copilot/tickets: This folder contains all generated tickets
- copilot/dept: This folder contains tickets that contain tasks that are not related to the functionality of the project but aim for general improvements, i.e. refactoring, improving the architecture, improving the process, and so on.

Always load the context file before starting to process information. They are the basis for understanding your work and the project.
